title: My Mac Apps
author: The Lemon
body:
Yeah, so uhh, it's me, The Lemon again. I'm glad to see that my app Nexus has been getting downloads, and in the past 2 days, I've gotten 4 downloads, which actually shocked me. It's much more than I expected, and I'd like to thank all my users. Make sure to leave a review though in the feedback tab!

But anyway, I'm primarily a Mac user. I have a MacBook Air M2, so not exactly the best. I use a Windows PC to package my apps only, but this means there are sometimes UI issues that are Windows specific that I don't see. If you see one or don't like something, feel free to tell me via feedback in the feedback page. So, here are all the apps I use and recommend to all other Mac users, developer or not:

- Aerial
- Vorssaint
- Spotify
- Zen Browser
- Nexus (By yours truly)
- Almandine PC (Same here)
- Lemon Studio (And again here)
- Droppy (Notch App)
- DockDoor
- GrandPerspective
- Raycast

That's all, but I will update this every time I get a new app to use. Most of these apps are free, with the exception of Spotify (Premium), Droppy and Almandine PC.

Also, a note: Almandine PC hasn't been released at the time this blog was made, and Lemon Studio still hasn't started development. I am using an early build of Almandine PC and expecting Lemon Studio to be good.
